rows.printed: St Katherine's L.H., Isle of Wight, _Nil._
rows.name: St Katherine's

notes:
The list is entirely on n43.jpg (printed page 28). It comes right after the main East Coast list (Longstone to Hanois, pp. 27-28) and right before 'Independent assistance...'. It has six rows, which matches the 'six stations' in the lead-in. There is no separate printed sub-heading. The coast value 'South East Coast' comes from the lead-in sentence, under the page/section heading 'EAST COAST OF ENGLAND'.

How things are written:
- Every 'Nil.' is printed in italics, so it is shown as _Nil._ in printed. In other it is written plain as 'Nil.'.
- The station types are set in small capitals (l.h./l.v.) and are written here as L.H./L.V.
- The leader dots between the station and keeper columns are not reproduced.
- There are no numbers, marks or light characters in this list.

Spellings and other points:
- 'St Katherine's' is printed with a K. The usual spelling is St Catherine's, but it is copied as printed. It is the only row with a place ('Isle of Wight'), and that is followed by a comma before _Nil._.
- 'Royal Sovereign Shoals' is printed with 'Shoals'.
- Nab L.V. is the only station with a keeper, F. Conconi. This matches the lead-in, which says only the Nab sent a schedule back. The surname is clearly 'Conconi' in the scan; the OCR line was garbled ('Nabi. < : , F. Conconi.').
- In the OCR, Dungeness's type looks a little uneven ('L.H.' with tight spacing), but in the image it reads L.H.
- On the same page, Hanois L.H., Guernsey (Chas. Williams and Geo. Freeman) belongs to the main East Coast list, not to this one.
